title: Wake managers from durable significant events with periodic safety checks
description: Landing failure, canonical check regression, stuck queues, deployment failure, approval waits and at-risk work should publish bounded project events. A persistent watcher coalesces/deduplicates and routes to the responsible manager; quiet timers act as a safety net. Do not expose private reasoning or replace existing authoritative task/message ledgers.
acceptanceCriteria: Events persist across restart and are replayed idempotently within a bounded window
Quiet fleet does not burn an AI wake on every poll; significant exceptions route once under budget
Owner notifications require approved targets and decisions needing the owner; no public event log by default
